items.title: Strengthening our safety ecosystem with external testing

items.summary: Introducing GPT-5.1-Codex-Max, a faster, more intelligent agentic coding model for Codex. The model is designed for long-running, project-scale work with enhanced reasoning and token efficiency.

items.title: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max System Card
items.summary: This system card outlines the comprehensive safety measures implemented for GPT‑5.1-CodexMax. It details both model-level mitigations, such as specialized safety training for harmful tasks and prompt injections, and product-level mitigations like agent sandboxing and configurable network access.

items.title: A free version of ChatGPT built for teachers
